game.name: Neon White
game.rules:
- ***A video of your run must be linked in your submission.*** A video must include both the start and the end of your run. Twitch VODs (as of 2025-03-20) and Xbox clips MUST be uploaded to a permanent video uploading source. **Game sounds must be audible in your submission**, with the exception of music, which can be muted.

- **The timer should be visible at all times.** Runs with an applicable in-game timer should be timed with in-game time, leave the "Time" field empty, as RTA is not used for the boards. Level times should be accurately submitted in-game time with three decimal places. If the third decimal is not submitted and is not visible, your time will be rounded to .xx9.
- **Pausing: No pauses allowed for IL runs.** Rushes are allowed to pause/adjust game settings, but **only in-between levels**. Pausing during levels is not allowed. Pauses in rushes **can't total more than 5 minutes**. If a player did accidentally or otherwise happen to pause during a rush level, but is not deemed to have gained an advantage from doing so, the run **MIGHT** be allowed, at a verifier's discretion.

**Any edits to the game files that modify the color of cards or any gameplay-related audio, is an automatic rejection.** The only modifications allowed to the game are:

- Modifying game file music/level complete phrases

- Modifications/removal of card icons/text

- Changing powerprefs.txt settings

- Modifications to player portrait/backstory

- Using approved mods/FPS changers with a hotkey and controller emulation (FPS changers cannot be used to go below 30fps).

**Console exclusive rules**:

- Using any console emulators for runs is banned.

- Any runs using the Xbox Game Pass version, must be submitted under the "Xbox" system category.

- Any Xbox runs that do not showcase a leaderboard and reselect the level on the job archive will have their times rounded up to .xx9.
- PlayStation runs must be done with **controller only**. Use of keyboard and mouse is not allowed.

**Runs that are Seeded must have the seed provided in the run's description.** Failure to do so can result in a rejection.

***Approved mods:***

- NeonLite
- Event Tracker
- Custom visual packs (card colors must stay default) 
- NeonNetwork
- Chapter rush mod
- Input Display
- GUnJammer/FullSync
